method: Same-agent English/Marathi block-by-block close reading, reverse reconstruction of axiom validity and the induction on axiomatic derivations, direct replay of the modus-ponens and quantified-rule cases, and exact formula, macro, token, label and reference comparison with two documented source projections. No independent human or native-speaker review is claimed.
scope: Soundness of axiomatic deduction: validity of the axiom schemas, semantic preservation through modus ponens and the quantified rule, weak soundness, and satisfiability-to-consistency soundness.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The section defines soundness as the guarantee that a derivation system cannot derive what fails semantically, then separates validity, consequence preservation and the inconsistency-to-unsatisfiability guarantee.
samples.checks: The three implication directions, proof-theoretic vocabulary and distinction between validity, entailment, consistency and satisfiability are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Every axiom is semantically true. For q1, universal satisfaction supplies the instance at the value of t, and the free-for substitution lemma gives satisfaction of A with t substituted for x.
samples.checks: The q1 reference, free-for condition, assignment update, term value, substitution formula and FOL/propositional branches are exact.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: If Gamma derives A, then Gamma entails A. Induction handles axioms and assumptions at the base and uses semantic modus ponens when the final step follows from B and B-implies-A.
samples.checks: The theorem direction, induction measure, base alternatives, two induction hypotheses and semantic Deduction Theorem reference are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: For the universal quantified-rule case, freshness of c lets a model be modified so c denotes an arbitrary assignment value; extensionality and substitution transfer satisfaction from B(c) to B(x), yielding the universal conclusion. The existential companion case is left as the stated exercise.
samples.checks: Freshness covers Gamma, C and the quantified conclusion; the modified structure, sentence facts, assignment, substitution identity and entailment steps retain their order. OLAXD-007 and OLAXD-008 restore two omitted protected-formula markers only.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The reader completes the FOL case. Derivability without premises yields validity or tautologicity; satisfiability implies consistency because an inconsistent premise set derives falsity, which no structure or valuation can satisfy.
samples.checks: The tagged exercise, weak-soundness direction, contrapositive proof, falsity formula and FOL/propositional alternatives are preserved.

source_observations: OLAXD-007 records the missing protected-formula marker in the frozen quantified-rule conclusion; the Marathi target restores !B(x) and leaves the distinct freshness-condition quotation unchanged.

OLAXD-008 records the missing protected-formula marker in the frozen satisfaction statement; the Marathi target restores !B(c), matching the immediately surrounding entailment and substitution formulas.
All remaining formulas, macros, protected tokens, labels, identifiers and reference options match after the two narrow documented projections.
limitations: No independent human or native-speaker review has been performed.
निर्दोषता, सिद्धतायोग्यता and the proof-theoretic terminology remain governed by provisional project decisions T155, T184 and T122.
The existential quantified-rule case remains an exercise in the frozen source and was not supplied in the translation.
